main_text.p: עַלְעִין m. p. Chal. Costa, Dan.7.5. ex Hebraeo עֲלַע mutato ע in א , ut alias saepè.
עָלַף Pyhal עָלַף Tegi, Obtegi: Animo deficere. Hithpahel הִתְעַלַּף idem.
עָמַד Stetit, Substitit, Mansit, Permansit: Hiphil הֶעֱמִיד Stare, Subsistere, Permanere fecit: Statuit, Statuit, Constituit. Hophal הָעֳמַד Sisti, Constitui, Distineri, Stabiliri.
עָמוּד m. Columna, Statua: plur. עַמּוּדִים.
עָמֵל m. Laboriosus, Aeruminosus, Molestus: plur. עֲמֵלִים.
עָמַם Tegere, Operire. Abscondere: Obscurare, ex usu Chaldaico. Hophal Futurum יֵעָם Obscuratur, Thren.4.1.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are reproduced from the scan as best legible; some vowel points and dagesh marks are uncertain. Bottom-right mark עם is the catchword.
